summary: Centre County, PA tree lookout built in 1915 and reported no longer standing; a 1935 survey also describes a CCC-built observation tower on the summit.

facts.design: Tree-mounted observation post, 35 ft above ground (1915 entry); a 1935 survey also describes a 25-ft CCC-built observation tower on the summit
facts.status_note: Register says the 1915 tree tower is no longer standing; the 1935 observation tower's fate is not stated in the sources read

access.note: A Penn Lookout Trail sign and a footpath lead toward the site, per a photo caption that places it in the Thickhead Mountain Wild Area of Rothrock State Forest. No access rules found.

visit.trail_note: Half-mile footpath leading to a clearing the photo caption says is likely the tower site; the caption places a Penn Lookout Trail sign at the Detweiler Road junction

corrections.why: 7.6 m equals the 25-foot CCC observation tower that a 1935 survey describes on the summit. The register record is for the 1915 tree tower, which Forest Lookouts gives as 35 feet (about 10.7 m).

corrections.proposed: Remove. Thickhead Wild Area is a place name, not an agency; the photo caption places it inside Rothrock State Forest.
corrections.why: Forest Lookouts uses the wild area name as a location line, and no page read names a managing agency.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register describes a 1915 tree tower that is no longer standing. A 1935 survey describes a 25-foot CCC observation tower on the same summit. The sources do not say whether these are the same structure, so the story reports both and does not link them.

notes_for_editor: The brief's coordinates (40.747, -77.697) are not supported by any page read here; the register says no coordinates are available, so check them before publishing. The 'public' access level rests on an unofficial Flickr photo caption, not an agency page; a Rothrock State Forest source would firm it up. The fate of the 1935 CCC observation tower is not stated anywhere read. Caption and trail details come from one personal photo page, so today's status is low-confidence. Used 2 WebSearch calls and 6 page reads (plus cached re-greps); the Wikipedia lead for the Wild Area returned 404.
